To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
entrepreneurial orientation is positively associated with firm performance and this relationship is partially explained by differentiation strategy and innovation.
differentiation strategy and innovation are the mediating mechanisms between entrepreneurial orientation and performance of firms.

differentiation strategy and innovation mediate the relationship of EO with firm performance and differentiation strategy mediates also the relationship of EO and innovation performance in manufacturing industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of differentiation strategy and innovation on firm performance.
the mediating role that differentiation strategy and innovation performances have on the relationship between EO on firm performance.
the mediating role between entrepreneurial orientation and performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mediating role between differentiation strategy and innovation is stronger than the one between EO and firm.
differentiation strategy and innovation performances mediate the relationship in between EO and firm Performance.
differentiation strategy and innovation performances are two different mediating factors in the relationship between EO on the one hand, and firm performance on the other hand.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
differentiation strategy mediates all the relationships between entrepreneurial orientation and its outcomes.

the results of this study provide a new perspective to the literature by showing that both differentiation strategy, innovation performance and their interaction are important in the process of linking entrepreneurial orientation to firm performance.
differentiation strategy and innovation are the key factors that make the EO effective in terms of firm performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of EO on firm performance is not only direct but it is also indirect through innovation performance and differentiation strategies.

the relationship between EO, firm performance, and differentiation strategy is a complex relationship and the effects of EO are not only directly on firm performance but it also indirectly affects firm performance through differentiation strategy and innovation.
the mediating effects of differentiation strategy and innovation on the relationship between EO dimensions and firm performance should be considered in the strategy literature.
